text: 2b.2-M EK DALGA TAMAM: MapManager zinciri donor'dan alindi (struct'a CustStore/CustPick/PkDropItem/DeathGate/AllowTradeSafe + 6 getter + CheckMap; SPK GetMapNonPK(obj,target) gPKFree zinciri korunarak geri eklendi), Load canli 16-kolon sirasina adapte edildi (canli baslik: ...CustAtt CustStore CustPick PkDrop Trade DeathGate Name; donor sirasi desync olurdu -> AllowTradeSafe=0/PartyEnable=1 sabit), CustomPick.cpp tam donor oldu (OnPickClose refactor + TradeDuel kontrolleri + GetMapCustomPick gate; 2x GetMessage(36) rename), CustomAttack/OfflineMode CustAtt getter adina gecti.
